description: Implementation of state query cast conversions for OpenGL, including functions to convert and cast various GL state values and query types.

methods.name: ExpandFloatToInteger
methods.description: Converts a GLfloat to a 64-bit integer by scaling and adjusting the value.

methods.name: CastFromStateValueToInt
methods.description: Casts a state value to an integer type, with special handling for float types.

methods.name: CastQueryValueToInt
methods.description: Converts a query value to an integer type, with rounding for float types.

methods.name: CastMaskValue
methods.description: Casts an unsigned int to a signed GLint.

methods.name: CastFromGLintStateValue
methods.description: Casts a GLint-based state value to a specific type.

methods.name: CastFromStateValue
methods.description: General function to cast a state value to a query type based on native type.

methods.name: CastQueryValueTo
methods.description: Converts a query value to a native type based on the native type.

methods.name: CastStateValues
methods.description: Retrieves multiple state values from the context and casts them to the specified query type.

methods.name: CastIndexedStateValues
methods.description: Retrieves indexed state values from the context and casts them to the specified query type.
